list.a: A French gentleman strolling with a long baguette under his arm: tilted navy beret, big curly moustache, striped top.
A short-beaked echidna waddling along side on: brown body, cream spines, long thin snout, short clawed legs.
A knight in steel armour with a red plume and tabard, holding a sword upright.
A wizard in a long purple robe and tall bent hat, white beard, staff with a glowing orb.
A friendly boxy robot with an antenna and a cyan visor, waving one claw hand.
An astronaut in a white suit and gold visor with a backpack, waving hello.
A ninja in a ready stance: dark blue hood, black headband with flying tails, one hand forward.
An orange tabby cat sitting tall with a white chest and paws, tail curled up behind.
A cream puppy standing side on with floppy brown ears, a brown back patch, red collar and wagging tail.
A friendly sheet ghost drifting along with its arms up and a wavy trailing tail.
A cheerful green slime mid-bounce, with a shiny top, big eyes, a smile and a little drip.
A small red dragon standing proud, golden horns and belly, wing raised and tail curled.
A green visitor with antennae and big slanted eyes, in a silver suit, holding a ray gun.
A pirate in a black tricorn and long red coat, eye patch and black beard, spyglass in hand.
A chef in a tall white hat and buttoned jacket, checked trousers, frying pan held out.
A red racing car side on, driver in a white helmet, white number roundel and rear wing.
A white rocket lifting off: red nose and fins, round window, red and white flame.
A cactus creature out for a walk, arms up, pink cheeks, pink flower on top and on one arm.
A skeleton out for a stroll: grinning skull, ribs and spine, one bony hand waving.
A green frog crouched side on, ready to hop: big eyes, wide smile, cream belly, spotted back.
A brown owl perched on a branch, ear tufts up, big cream eyes looking sideways, speckled chest.
A brown bear standing on its hind legs, cream muzzle and belly, one paw waving.
An old-style deep-sea diver: brass helmet with portholes, air hose, weight belt and heavy boots.
A cowboy in a wide tan hat, vest and blue jeans, hand on hip, lasso loop ready.
A king in a gold crown and long purple robe with a gold trim, holding a sceptre.
A penguin waddling along, one flipper out, orange beak and feet.
A red fox trotting side on, bushy white-tipped tail raised, white chest and dark legs.
A wild brown rabbit sitting up side on, long ears raised, cream chest and white tail.
A small grey field mouse scurrying side on, pink ear, nose and feet, long thin tail.
A pink farm pig walking side on, ears flopped forward, flat snout and a curly tail.
A black and white dairy cow standing side on, pink nose and udder, tail hanging.
A chestnut horse trotting side on, one front hoof raised, dark mane and tail, white blaze.
A woolly white sheep standing side on with a black face, black legs and a fluffy fleece.
A stocky white goat with a red-brown head, curved horns, floppy ear and a short tail flicked up.
A tall giraffe standing side on, long spotted neck stretched up, little horns and a tufted tail.
A grey elephant walking side on with its trunk raised high, big ear, white tusk.
A lion walking side on with a big shaggy mane, tawny coat and a dark tuft on its tail.
A striped tiger prowling side on, head low and alert, white chin and belly, tail curled up.
A giant panda sitting up and holding a green bamboo stalk, black eye patches, ears, arms and legs.
A brown monkey sitting with one arm raised, holding up a yellow banana, long tail curled.
A grey shark swimming side on, tall dorsal fin, white belly and a crescent tail.
A red octopus floating face on, big round head, wide eyes and eight curling arms.
A green sea turtle swimming seen from above, smooth patterned shell and big front flippers.
A garden snail gliding along with its striped spiral shell and eyes up on long stalks.
A red shore crab facing out, claws raised and open, eyes up on stalks, legs out to the sides.
A red squirrel sitting up with a huge curled bushy tail, holding a brown acorn in its paws.
A red deer stag standing alert side on, branching antlers, a pale throat and rump, short tail.
A scarlet macaw perched side on, red head and body, yellow and blue wings, a long tail.
A pink flamingo standing on one long leg, the other tucked up, neck curved and a bent black-tipped beak.
A big blue whale cruising side on, blowing a spout of water, pale grooved throat and a raised tail.
A grey hippo with its head thrown back in a huge yawn, pink mouth and white tusks.
A red kangaroo standing tall on its big back feet and tail, a little joey peeking out of its pouch.
A grey koala hugging a pale gum tree trunk: fluffy white-edged ears, big black nose, arms wrapped round the tree.
A stocky wombat trundling along side on: round brown body, short strong legs, small ears and a broad black nose.
A platypus paddling along side on: flat black duck bill, sleek brown body, webbed feet and a wide flat tail.
An emu running flat out side on: shaggy brown body, long neck stretched forward, blue throat and big striding legs.
A kookaburra laughing on a branch, head thrown back and big beak open: cream head and chest, brown wings with blue flecks.
A sulphur-crested cockatoo showing off with wings half open and its yellow crest fanned up high.
A smiling quokka sitting up on its long back feet, little paws held together in front of its round tummy.
A black Tasmanian devil snarling side on: white band across its chest, pink ears and a wide open pink mouth with white teeth.
A ginger dingo standing alert side on: pricked ears, white paws and chest, bushy tail with a white tip.
A ringtail possum perched on a branch with big dark eyes, its long tail curled into a ring below with a white tip.
A sugar glider gliding seen from above, arms and legs stretched out wide, dark stripe down its back and big eyes.
A frill-necked lizard running upright on its back legs, the big red frill flared round its open mouth.
A saltwater crocodile lying low side on with its long jaws wide open, white teeth showing and a ridged tail.
An Australian magpie swooping in, wings raised: black and white feathers, pale beak and a red-brown eye.
A cassowary standing tall: shaggy black body, bright blue neck, dangling red wattles and a tall casque on its head.
A galah hanging upside down from a branch by its feet, showing off its rosy pink chest, grey wings and pale crown.
A bilby sniffing along side on: huge pink ears, long pointed snout, soft grey fur and a black tail.
A numbat walking side on: rusty red coat with white stripes across its back, dark eye stripe and a bushy raised tail.
A blue-tongue lizard side on with banded brown and cream scales, short legs and its fat blue tongue poking out.
A superb lyrebird on the forest floor with its tail fanned up over its back like a lyre, lacy white plumes between.
An Australian pelican standing side on: white body, black wings and tail, and a huge pale pink bill and pouch.
A lace monitor goanna striding side on with its head raised, dark scales banded in yellow and a forked red tongue.
A grey-headed flying fox hanging upside down from a branch, one leathery wing half open and an orange collar.
A rainbow lorikeet perched with wings slightly open: blue head, orange chest, green back and long pointed tail.
An elf archer in a green tunic with long brown hair and pointed ears, holding a bow out in front.
A stout dwarf in a brown helmet and tunic, with a long ginger beard in two braids and an axe at his side.
A hunched green orc warrior with big tusks, a black topknot and shoulder pad, raising a cleaver.
A big teal troll with a huge nose, scruffy brown hair and a cream belly, a knobbly club over his shoulder.
A tiny fairy with pale blue wings and a pink dress, floating with a wand that sparkles at the tip.
A witch in a pointed black hat and dress, ginger hair streaming, flying along on a broomstick.
A paladin in gold armour with an open helmet, a big round shield and a war hammer raised high.
A barbarian with long wild hair, a fur loincloth and boots, swinging a huge sword up over his shoulder.
A bard in a feathered red cap and tunic, strumming a golden lute and tapping one foot.
A young druid in a deep green hooded robe tied with a rope belt, holding a staff topped with antlers.
A pale vampire with slicked black hair and fangs, sweeping open a high-collared black cape lined in red.
A shaggy werewolf in ripped blue trousers, snout raised in a howl, claws out.
A mummy wrapped in cream bandages, shuffling forward with both arms out and a loose end trailing.
A friendly zombie with pale green skin, messy hair and a torn shirt, smiling and waving hello.
A green genie with a black topknot and gold armbands, arms folded, rising in a swirl from a golden lamp.
A mermaid with long dark hair and a sea green tail and shell top, sitting on a rock with her fin raised.
A centaur with a tan horse body and dark mane and tail, standing tall with a spear in hand.
A muscly minotaur with a bull head, long cream horns and a nose ring, stomping along with fists clenched.
A one-eyed cyclops giant with a big grin and a brown tunic, lifting a heavy boulder up on one hand.
A little gnome with a tall red pointed hat and a long cream beard, holding up a glowing lantern.
A sneaky lime green goblin with wide pointed ears, a long nose and a toothy grin, clutching a little dagger.
A white unicorn prancing side on, with a golden spiral horn and a flowing violet mane and tail.
A phoenix with fiery red, orange and yellow wings spread wide and long flame feathers trailing behind.
A hulking stone golem made of cracked grey blocks, with moss on its head, glowing green eyes and big fists.
A jester in a red and gold diamond suit and a floppy two-pointed hat with bells, juggling three balls.
A firefighter in a red helmet and coat with black bands, aiming a black hose nozzle.
A nurse in teal scrubs and a white scrub cap, one hand on her hip, holding up a syringe.
A doctor in a long white coat with a stethoscope round the neck, holding a clipboard.
A farmer in a wide straw hat and blue bib overalls, chewing a straw, pitchfork in hand.
A builder in a yellow hard hat and hi-vis vest with navy stripes, swinging a hammer up high.
A painter in a long blue smock with paint spots, holding a palette and raising a brush.
A postie in a blue cap, shirt and shorts with a brown satchel, holding out a letter.
A scientist in a white lab coat and green goggles, holding up a bubbling flask.
A teacher in a brown jumper and green tie, pointing a stick at a small green chalkboard on an easel.
A mechanic in a work shirt with rolled sleeves and a cap on backwards, a big spanner raised.
A gardener in a sun hat, green apron and orange gumboots, pouring a watering can over a sprout.
An airline pilot in a peaked cap and dark jacket with gold buttons, pulling a wheeled bag.
A sailor in a round white cap and navy uniform with a white square collar, saluting.
A lifeguard in red shorts and sunglasses with a whistle, a red rescue tube under one arm.
A librarian with glasses and a hair bun in a violet cardigan, carrying a tall stack of books.
A photographer in an orange vest full of pockets, camera raised to one eye.
A rock guitarist with long hair in a wide stance, strumming a red electric guitar.
A marching drummer in a tall plumed hat and blue jacket, sticks up over a side drum.
An orchestra conductor in a black tailcoat and bow tie, swept white hair, baton raised high.
A stage magician in a black top hat and red-lined cape, waving a wand that sparkles.
A juggler in a violet shirt and baggy yellow trousers, three balls flying in an arc overhead.
An explorer in a pith helmet and khaki shirt, tall brown boots, looking through binoculars.
A miner in a yellow helmet with a shining head lamp, dusty grey clothes, carrying a pick.
A lumberjack in a red checked shirt and beanie, holding a big axe upright.
A beekeeper in a white suit, wide hat and dark veil, holding a honeycomb frame with bees about.
A farm tractor driving along side on: red bonnet and cab, a tall exhaust pipe, a huge back wheel and a small front wheel.
A double-decker bus side on: tall red body, two rows of windows, a cream band between the decks and black wheels.
An old steam engine puffing along side on: green boiler, black chimney and smokebox, a cab at the back and big wheels.
A fire engine side on: red body with a white ladder on the roof, a white stripe, a light on the cab and black wheels.
A little submarine cruising along: orange hull, round portholes, a tall periscope, a propeller and a few bubbles.
A rescue helicopter flying side on: yellow body with a big round window, long tail with a small rotor, black blades and skids.
A small sailing boat on the waves: two white sails, a tall mast with a little flag and a blue hull.
A hot air balloon floating up: a round envelope in red and yellow stripes, thin ropes and a woven basket.
A rider on a motorbike leaning forward: blue helmet and fuel tank, black jacket, grey engine and two spoked wheels.
An old biplane flying side on: yellow body and two wings, a pilot in a navy helmet with a white scarf, a spinning propeller.
A friendly teapot walking on little legs: round green body, a smiling face, a curved spout and a lid worn like a hat.
A cheerful alarm clock on little legs: round red case, white dial with a smiling face, two bells on top and waving arms.
A happy umbrella hopping on its curved handle: purple canopy with a smiling face, little arms waving.
An open book on little legs: blue cover, two white pages with lines of text, a smiling face across the middle and waving arms.
A walking pencil with its sharp point up like a hat: yellow body, a smiling face, a band and rubber at the bottom, little legs.
An old television set on splayed legs: wooden cabinet, a smiling face on the screen, two knobs and rabbit ear aerials.
A bright light bulb on little legs: glowing yellow glass with a smiling face, a grey screw base and arms out wide.
A smiling kettle on little legs: red body, a black handle over the top, a spout puffing white steam.
A shaggy white yeti waving both arms in the air: grey face, hands and feet, a big open grin.
A friendly swamp monster dripping with weed: lumpy green body, long arms, big round eyes and a lily pad on its head.
A round furry orange monster with one cream horn, big eyes and a wide happy mouth, waving a little arm.
A stone gargoyle crouched on a plinth: bat wings raised behind, little horns, pale eyes and a toothy grin.
A lumbering rock monster made of stacked boulders: cracks in its body, glowing eyes, one stony fist raised.
A cheeky little imp leaping along: pink skin, small yellow horns, pointed ears, a toothy grin and a tail with an arrow tip.
A space captain in a plain blue uniform with a short cape, pointing the way ahead.
A pink tentacled alien with a big round head, two wide eyes and six curling tentacles.
A tall slim one-eyed alien in a dark tunic, waving a long three-fingered hand.
An alien made of glassy crystal facets, with a diamond head and sharp shards on its shoulders.
A round ball robot rolling at speed, with a face screen, a striped band and a short antenna.
A robot rolling on tank tracks, with a slim red column body, a grey dome head and a reaching claw arm.
A slim android walking with long strides: pale blue face and hands, panel seams and a violet bodysuit.
A small hover drone with two spinning rotors, a round orange body and a happy face.
A two-legged walking mech suit striding along, its pilot looking out of the cockpit window.
A blue robot dog standing alert, with pointed metal ears, a glowing eye and an antenna tail.
A robot butler in a black tailcoat and bow tie, holding a tray with a cup high on one hand.
A wind-up tin toy robot marching stiffly, a big gold key turning in its back.
A cyborg with spiky hair, a metal eyepiece and one big robotic arm flexed up.
An armoured space trooper in orange and grey plates, with a round helmet and a narrow dark visor.
A flying saucer with a ring of lights and a glass dome, a small green pilot waving inside.
A rider in a pink helmet leaning low over a sleek hover bike, cyan glow under it and from the thruster.
A jetpack pilot flying upward in goggles, one arm reaching ahead, twin flames blasting below.
A six-wheeled moon rover side on, gold body, a camera mast and a small dish on top.
A smiling satellite floating in space, gold body, blue solar panels out wide and a dish on top.
A time traveller in a long brown coat and goggled hat, holding up a glowing pocket gadget.
A space miner in a yellow suit and helmet lamp, bracing a big rock drill as chips fly.
A squat green robot with a white radar dish on its head sending out signal waves.
A six-legged alien pet scurrying along, green and spotted, with big eyes on stalks and a curly tail.
An android medic in white with a teal visor and a heart on its chest, carrying a first aid case.
A robot gardener in a sun hat and green apron, proudly holding a pot with a tiny sprout.
A soccer player in a blue shirt and black shorts, kicking a ball with arms out for balance.
An Australian rules footballer leaping for a high mark, arms up to catch the red oval ball, one knee raised.
A cricket batter in whites and a navy helmet with a face grille, driving the bat through low.
A cricket bowler in whites mid-delivery, bowling arm high over the head with the red ball, front leg braced.
A tennis player with a ponytail and lime headband, swinging a forehand at a lime ball.
A basketball player in an orange singlet and shorts, bent low and dribbling the ball.
A surfer in black board shorts walking with a long white surfboard under one arm.
A skateboarder in a backwards cap and blue hoodie, knees bent, popping the board into an ollie.
A swimmer doing freestyle in a light blue cap and dark goggles, one arm reaching over, water splashing.
A cyclist in a red jersey and helmet, bent low over the handlebars of a black road bike.
A sprinter in a green singlet at full stride, knee high and arms pumping, leaning into the run.
A boxer in a fighting stance with red gloves up by the chin, red shorts and black boots.
A karate student in a white gi and black belt, leaning back into a high side kick.
A golfer in a pink polo and cap at the end of a swing, club over the shoulder, back heel up.
A skier in a red jacket and goggles crouched low on the skis, poles out, heading down the slope.
A snowboarder in a teal jacket and pompom beanie, knees bent and arms out for balance on the board.
A figure skater spinning on one skate, arms joined high overhead, pink dress flaring out.
An ice hockey player in a dark red jersey and black helmet, skating hard with the stick on the puck.
A baseball batter in a blue helmet and uniform, bat cocked high behind the head, waiting for the pitch.
A target archer in a green shirt drawing a recurve bow, string pulled back to the chin, arrow ready.
A fencer in a white suit and dark mesh mask lunging forward, foil out straight, back arm raised.
A weightlifter in a purple singlet holding a heavy barbell straight overhead, feet planted wide.
A rock climber in an ochre helmet reaching up an ochre rock face, one foot high on a hold, rope running up.
A gymnast in a magenta leotard balancing in a handstand, legs split wide and toes pointed.
A lawn bowler in whites and a wide sun hat, crouched low with one knee down, rolling a black bowl.
